title: Étude Prologue: Yureugoku Kokoro no Katachi
native_title: エチュード・プロローグ ～揺れ動く心のかたち～
overview:
Tatsuya Gunji and Hitomi Saeki were once a couple. Now both are third-year high school students with only two months left before graduation, and neither is sure what comes next. Tatsuya has no clear goal for his future, while Hitomi is undecided about her path and still carries feelings about the past they shared.

Choose to play as either Tatsuya or Hitomi and live out the days leading up to graduation. Plan each day's schedule, build up your abilities, take on part-time jobs and spend time with the people around you as you decide where your life goes after school. The other characters take on different roles depending on whose side you play, and seeing both stories reveals what really happened between the two and how everyone around them truly feels.

- Two protagonists, one male and one female
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
